limiteDiario.extrasHoje: Limit of {{limit}} + {{extra}} extra released for today.
limiteDiario.atingido: Daily limit reached. New messages from this line are being refused until the day turns over.
limiteDiario.semLimite: No active limit. {{sent}} messages sent today.
limiteDiario.usoIndisponivel: Today's usage could not be read right now. Reload the page in a moment.
limiteDiario.liberarHintSalvar: Enable and save the daily limit to release a temporary limit.
limiteDiario.liberarDescricao: Extra messages are valid for today only. When the day turns over, the limit goes back to the configured value.
limiteDiario.liberado: Temporary limit released: +{{amount}} messages for today.
limiteDiario.erroLiberar: Could not release the temporary limit.
